story.title: Giving it back to the society
paragraphs_en: There was a girl named Shifa who lived in Kolkata. She loved to help poor people. Her mother worked for an NGO under Mother Teresa’s mission. So she used to hear a lot of stories about Nobel work done by mother Teresa. Mother Teresa became her idol. At the age of 16 she even travelled to cities like Delhi, Mumbai etc to help the poor people.

She was inspired by the selflessness of mother Teresa and wanted to dedicate herself in helping the poor people. From there her new journey started. She even started collecting funds to help the poor people. The funds were used to provide clothes, food , medicines and even pay for children’s education , books ect.
Shifa learnt that her happiness was in helping needy by all means. She dedicated herself to that mission.
